shared_elements: sculpture in the round of a creature
massive blocky body volume with rounded contours
facial features (eyes/mouth or beak) rendered by shallow incised lines on a smooth mass
justification: Both depict a creature as a heavy, block-like three-dimensional mass whose only detail is a set of lightly incised features on the head (eyes, mouth/beak), a shared schematic convention of volume-over-detail. But the subjects differ substantially: A is a full-bodied four-legged predator shown with elongated trunk, limbs and toothed jaws, while B is a frontal head/bust of a raptor- or owl-like being with paired eyes and a central beak and no body or legs, so there is no correspondence in the elements combined or their arrangement.
